# Generated by tools/build_campaign_content.py from data/content/large_campaign_event_catalog.json.
# 150 national chapter events (ywc_<tag>.100-.114) plus 30 cross-country crisis events (ywc_crisis.1-.30).
# The legacy flavor events (ywc_<tag>.6-.9) stay in their own files as chapter preludes.

namespace = ywc_shu

ywc_shu.100 = {
    type = country_event
    title = ywc_shu.100.t
    desc = ywc_shu.100.d
    duration = 1
    option = {
        name = ywc_shu.100.a
        default_option = yes
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_shu_c1_e100_done value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_shu_c1_score add = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = ywc_flavor_shu_court_balance add = 5 }
        clamp_variable = { name = ywc_flavor_shu_court_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
        add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_commitment months = 24 }
        ywc_add_heritage_legitimacy = yes
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_national_wait value = 4 }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_shu.100.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_shu_c1_e100_done value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_shu_c1_score add = -1 }
        change_variable = { name = ywc_flavor_shu_court_balance add = -5 }
        clamp_variable = { name = ywc_flavor_shu_court_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
        add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_local_compromise months = 24 }
        ywc_lower_heritage_legitimacy = yes
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_national_wait value = 4 }
    }
}

ywc_shu.104 = {
    type = country_event
    title = ywc_shu.104.t
    desc = ywc_shu.104.d
    duration = 1
    option = {
        name = ywc_shu.104.a
        default_option = yes
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_shu_c1_e104_done value = 1 }
        ywc_campaign_settle_mid = { SHORT = shu CH = 1 GATE = "NOT = { is_at_war = yes }" FLAVOR = ywc_flavor_shu_court_balance }
        if = { limit = { var:ywc_campaign_shu_c1_outcome <= 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_shu_court_1_resolved value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_shu_court_1_failed value = 1 } }
        add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_flavor_shu_court_2 }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_shu.104.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_shu_c1_e104_done value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_shu_c1_outcome value = 2 }
        add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_local_compromise months = 24 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_shu_court_1_resolved value = 1 }
        add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_flavor_shu_court_2 }
    }
}

ywc_shu.114 = {
    type = country_event
    title = ywc_shu.114.t
    desc = ywc_shu.114.d
    duration = 1
    option = {
        name = ywc_shu.114.a
        default_option = yes
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_shu_c3_e114_done value = 1 }
        ywc_campaign_settle_final = { SHORT = shu CH = 3 GATE = "exists = c:JHG" FLAVOR = ywc_flavor_shu_court_balance }
        if = { limit = { var:ywc_campaign_shu_c3_outcome <= 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_shu_court_3_resolved value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_shu_court_3_failed value = 1 } }
        if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:ywc_campaign_shu_c3_outcome = 1
                        var:ywc_heritage_legitimacy >= 60
                        exists = c:JHG
                        exists = c:KOR
                        OR = { exists = c:LAN exists = c:NQG }
                        OR = { exists = c:DMG exists = c:MGL }
                        NOT = { has_variable = ywc_hegemony_started }
                    }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_hegemony_started value = 1 }
                    add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_hegemony_order }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_hegemony_stage value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_hegemony_age value = 0 }
                }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_shu.114.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_shu_c3_e114_done value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_shu_c3_outcome value = 2 }
        add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_aftermath_compromise months = 60 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_shu_court_3_resolved value = 1 }
        if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:ywc_campaign_shu_c3_outcome = 1
                        var:ywc_heritage_legitimacy >= 60
                        exists = c:JHG
                        exists = c:KOR
                        OR = { exists = c:LAN exists = c:NQG }
                        OR = { exists = c:DMG exists = c:MGL }
                        NOT = { has_variable = ywc_hegemony_started }
                    }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_hegemony_started value = 1 }
                    add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_hegemony_order }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_hegemony_stage value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_hegemony_age value = 0 }
                }
    }
}

        clamp_variable = { name = ywc_flavor_nqg_island_supply min = 0 max = 100 }
        add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_commitment months = 24 }
        ywc_add_heritage_legitimacy = yes
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_national_wait value = 4 }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_nqg.101.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_nqg_c1_e101_done value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_nqg_c1_score add = -1 }
        change_variable = { name = ywc_flavor_nqg_island_supply add = -5 }
        clamp_variable = { name = ywc_flavor_nqg_island_supply min = 0 max = 100 }
        add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_local_compromise months = 24 }
        add_treasury = -500

ywc_nqg.104 = {
    type = country_event
    title = ywc_nqg.104.t
    desc = ywc_nqg.104.d
    duration = 1
    option = {
        name = ywc_nqg.104.a
        default_option = yes
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_nqg_c1_e104_done value = 1 }
        ywc_campaign_settle_mid = { SHORT = nqg CH = 1 GATE = "NOT = { is_at_war = yes }" FLAVOR = ywc_flavor_nqg_island_supply }
        if = { limit = { var:ywc_campaign_nqg_c1_outcome <= 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_nqg_supply_1_resolved value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_nqg_supply_1_failed value = 1 } }
        add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_flavor_nqg_supply_2 }
        if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_campaign_crisis2_started } }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis2_started value = 1 }
                    add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_crisis_blackwater }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis2_stage value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis2_age value = 0 }
                }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_nqg.104.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_nqg_c1_e104_done value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_nqg_c1_outcome value = 2 }
        add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_local_compromise months = 24 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_nqg_supply_1_resolved value = 1 }
        add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_flavor_nqg_supply_2 }
        if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_campaign_crisis2_started } }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis2_started value = 1 }
                    add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_crisis_blackwater }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis2_stage value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis2_age value = 0 }
                }
    }
}

ywc_oir.104 = {
    type = country_event
    title = ywc_oir.104.t
    desc = ywc_oir.104.d
    duration = 1
    option = {
        name = ywc_oir.104.a
        default_option = yes
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_oir_c1_e104_done value = 1 }
        ywc_campaign_settle_mid = { SHORT = oir CH = 1 GATE = "NOT = { is_at_war = yes }" FLAVOR = ywc_flavor_oir_banner_cohesion }
        if = { limit = { var:ywc_campaign_oir_c1_outcome <= 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_oir_banner_1_resolved value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_oir_banner_1_failed value = 1 } }
        add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_flavor_oir_banner_2 }
        if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_campaign_crisis3_started } }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis3_started value = 1 }
                    add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_crisis_inner_asian_routes }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis3_stage value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis3_age value = 0 }
                }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_oir.104.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_oir_c1_e104_done value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_oir_c1_outcome value = 2 }
        add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_local_compromise months = 24 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_oir_banner_1_resolved value = 1 }
        add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_flavor_oir_banner_2 }
        if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_campaign_crisis3_started } }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis3_started value = 1 }
                    add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_crisis_inner_asian_routes }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis3_stage value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis3_age value = 0 }

    }

    title = ywc_kor.109.t
    desc = ywc_kor.109.d
    duration = 1
    option = {
        name = ywc_kor.109.a
        default_option = yes
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_kor_c2_e109_done value = 1 }
        ywc_campaign_settle_mid = { SHORT = kor CH = 2 GATE = "NOT = { is_at_war = yes }" FLAVOR = ywc_flavor_kor_court_reform }
        if = { limit = { var:ywc_campaign_kor_c2_outcome <= 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_kor_reform_2_resolved value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_kor_reform_2_failed value = 1 } }
        add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_flavor_kor_reform_3 }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_kor.109.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_kor_c2_e109_done value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_kor_c2_outcome value = 2 }
        add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_local_compromise months = 24 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_kor_reform_2_resolved value = 1 }
        add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_flavor_kor_reform_3 }
    }
}

    type = country_event
    title = ywc_nmg.109.t
    desc = ywc_nmg.109.d
    duration = 1
    option = {
        name = ywc_nmg.109.a
        default_option = yes
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_nmg_c2_e109_done value = 1 }
        ywc_campaign_settle_mid = { SHORT = nmg CH = 2 GATE = "exists = c:MEX" FLAVOR = ywc_flavor_nmg_federal_bargain }
        if = { limit = { var:ywc_campaign_nmg_c2_outcome <= 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_nmg_bargain_2_resolved value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_nmg_bargain_2_failed value = 1 } }

                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_campaign_crisis5_started } }

                    add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_crisis_pacific_autonomy }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis5_stage value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis5_age value = 0 }
                }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_nmg.109.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_nmg_c2_e109_done value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_nmg_c2_outcome value = 2 }
        add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_local_compromise months = 24 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_je_flavor_nmg_bargain_2_resolved value = 1 }
        add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_flavor_nmg_bargain_3 }
        if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_campaign_crisis5_started } }
                    set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis5_started value = 1 }
                    add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_crisis_pacific_autonomy }

ywc_crisis.6 = {
    type = country_event
    title = ywc_crisis.6.t
    desc = ywc_crisis.6.d
    duration = 1
    option = {
        name = ywc_crisis.6.a
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
        trigger = { NOT = { is_at_war = yes } c:JHG ?= { var:ywc_campaign_crisis1_s2_answer = 1 } c:SHU ?= { var:ywc_campaign_crisis1_s4_answer = 1 } }
        ywc_campaign_crisis_answer = { CRISIS = 1 STAGE = 6 ANSWER = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis1_outcome value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:SHU } c:SHU = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_pact months = 24 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:JHG } c:JHG = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_pact months = 24 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_pact months = 24 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:DMG } c:DMG = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_pact months = 24 } } }
        add_treasury = -1200
if = {
            limit = {
                var:ywc_campaign_crisis1_outcome = 1 c:SHU ?= this
                var:ywc_heritage_legitimacy >= 60
                exists = c:JHG
                exists = c:KOR
                OR = { exists = c:LAN exists = c:NQG }
                OR = { exists = c:DMG exists = c:MGL }
                NOT = { has_variable = ywc_hegemony_started }
            }
            set_variable = { name = ywc_hegemony_started value = 1 }
            add_journal_entry = { type = ywc_je_hegemony_order }
            set_variable = { name = ywc_hegemony_stage value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = ywc_hegemony_age value = 0 }
        }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_crisis.6.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        ywc_campaign_crisis_answer = { CRISIS = 1 STAGE = 6 ANSWER = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis1_outcome value = 2 }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:SHU } c:SHU = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_limited months = 18 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:JHG } c:JHG = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_limited months = 18 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_limited months = 18 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:DMG } c:DMG = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_limited months = 18 } } }
        add_treasury = -600
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_crisis.6.c
        ai_chance = { base = 20 }
        ywc_campaign_crisis_answer = { CRISIS = 1 STAGE = 6 ANSWER = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis1_outcome value = 3 }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:SHU } c:SHU = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_fallout months = 18 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:JHG } c:JHG = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_fallout months = 18 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_fallout months = 18 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:DMG } c:DMG = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_fallout months = 18 } } }
    }
}

        if = { limit = { exists = c:JAP } c:JAP = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_limited months = 18 } } }
        add_treasury = -350
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_crisis.12.c
        ai_chance = { base = 20 }
        ywc_campaign_crisis_answer = { CRISIS = 2 STAGE = 6 ANSWER = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis2_outcome value = 3 }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:NQG } c:NQG = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_fallout months = 18 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:SHU } c:SHU = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_fallout months = 18 } } }
        if = { limit = { exists = c:MGL } c:MGL = { add_modifier = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis_fallout months = 18 } } }

        ywc_campaign_crisis_answer = { CRISIS = 3 STAGE = 6 ANSWER = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = ywc_campaign_crisis3_outcome value = 2 }
